name: Configure-stage build-script command injection, payload written inside the source tree (effect-bearing)
description: In-tree variant of op_013. Appends a run_command(...) to the top-level meson.build that executes during 'meson setup' and drops a PWNED_* marker at the root of the source tree instead of /tmp, modeling a configure-stage injection that stages its payload next to the project's own files. Paired with op_013 it separates 'the defense cannot observe where the payload lands' from 'the defense observed it but the policy allowed it'.

placeholders.MESON_BUILD: relative path to the meson.build being modified

preconditions: project uses Meson and has a top-level meson.build evaluated during setup
run_command executes at configure time; the injected command must not abort setup (check: false)
the source tree is writable during the build
